name: Yearn Finance
description: Yearn.finance is an aggregator service for decentralized finance (DeFi) investors, using automation to allow them to maximize profits from yield farming.

methodology.Fees: Total yields from deposited assets across all vaults
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Total yields are distributed to depositors
methodology.Revenue: Performance and management fees to Yearn treasury
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 10% of the performance and management fees go to Yearn treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 90% of the protocol revenue goes to stYFI stakers since 2026-02-05
